part.text:
Created `/workspace/middleware.ts` at the project root (where Next.js auto-discovers middleware).

- Uses `crypto.randomUUID()` (available in the Edge runtime) to generate a unique `X-Request-Id` per request.
- Logs `[Request <id>] <pathname>` to the console.
- Forwards incoming request headers onto `NextResponse.next()` and sets `X-Request-Id` on the outgoing response.
- `config.matcher` excludes static assets (`_next/static`, `_next/image`, `favicon.ico`) so we don't log noise.
